name: Example Team Scaffold
goal: Generate focused team roles and a plan for a bounded implementation task.
outcome: Project-local Claude agent definitions and an OMC plan are ready to review.
nonGoals: Do not start a daemon or background runtime.
Do not run tmux, MCP servers, or custom orchestration processes.
why: A producer creates the patch, a reviewer checks it, and a verifier records evidence before integration.
soloRisk: A single pass can miss review or validation gaps.
downshift: Use direct implementation when the task is tiny or one role can safely finish it.

roles.name: producer
roles.description: Implement the scoped change with minimal diff.
roles.mission: Implement the assigned change exactly, matching local conventions.
roles.writeScope: Only files named in the assigned task.
roles.forbiddenScope: Do not refactor adjacent code or edit registries unless assigned.
roles.outputContract: Report files changed, decisions, risks, and commands run.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.description: Review the produced patch for correctness and scope control.
roles.mission: Find correctness, simplicity, and scope issues before merge readiness.
roles.forbiddenScope: Do not edit production files during review.
roles.outputContract: Report findings with severity, file paths, and verification suggestions.

tasks.name: Implement patch
tasks.doneWhen: Scoped patch is ready and local diagnostics pass.

tasks.name: Review patch
tasks.doneWhen: Review findings are resolved or accepted with rationale.

watchdog.conflictEscalation: Pause and ask integrator before editing shared files.
watchdog.sharedFileRule: One writer per file; reviewers stay read-only.
watchdog.stopCondition: Acceptance criteria met and validation evidence recorded.
watchdog.isolation: Use worktrees only for parallel write lanes.

validation.name: Repository validation
validation.expected: Passes with no registry or reference drift.
